alerts.headline: Up to three lanes of southbound I-405 from 12th Avenue Southeast / Lake Washington Boulevard Southeast (milepost 9) to Northeast 44th Street (milepost 7.5) will be closed overnight, 11 p.m. Saturday, Sept. 12 – 8 a.m. Sunday, Sept. 13.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Tuesday, Sept. 8 to 5 a.m. Friday, Sept. 18 the northbound Interstate 405 off-ramp to Southeast 8th Street/Richards Road (milepost 12) traffic will alternate with flaggers for utilities work.
The 112th Avenue Southeast on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Coal Creek Parkway Southeast will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to 112th Avenue Southeast will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.

Starting Monday, Aug. 17, both directions of SR 169 in Black Diamond are closed between Southeast 332nd Street and Plass Road for 35 days for fish barrier removal. 

Separate signed detours will guide passenger vehicles and freight vehicles around the closure. 

Local access is permitted north and south of the closure, but through traffic must follow the signed detours. Businesses are open and accessible along SR 169 during this construction.

From 7 a.m. to 3 p.m. Monday, Sept. 14, State Route 203 traffic will alternate from Fay Road/Lake Marcel to 296th Avenue Northeast (milepost 9) for maintenance. This work may also need to occur on Tuesday, Sept. 15.

Westbound I-90 is reduced to three lanes near the 17th Street Northwest on-ramp to the Lakemont Boulevard off-ramp, with traffic shifts to accommodate construction. The HOV lane is open to all drivers.

From 9:30 p.m. Tuesday, Sept. 15 to 4:30 a.m. Wednesday, Sept. 16, two right lanes of northbound State Route 167 from James Street to 84th Avenue South/Central Avenue will close. The northbound SR 167 off-ramp to 84th Avenue South/Central Avenue (milepost 21) will also close.

From 9:30 p.m. Monday, Sept. 14 to 4:30 a.m. Tuesday, Sept. 15, two right lanes of northbound State Route 167 from State Route 516/Willis Street to James Street (milepost 20) will close. The on-ramp from State Route 516 will also close.

From 9:30 p.m. Thursday, Sept. 17 to 4:30 a.m. Friday, Sept. 18, two right lanes of northbound State Route 167 from South 192nd Street to South 180th Street/Southwest 43rd Avenue (milepost 24) will close for maintenance.
Saturday, September 12 to the morning of Sunday, September 13: One lane of northbound I-405 between milepost 17.45 and milepost 18.12 will be closed, nightly from 10 p.m.- 9 a.m.

The northbound/southbound I-405 on-/off-ramps at Northeast 85th Street (Exit 18) will close day and night from 10 p.m. Friday, Sept. 11 to 5 a.m. Monday, Sept. 14. Northeast 85th Street will also close from Sixth Street to 120th Avenue Northeast. Signed detours will be in place.
The northbound/southbound I-405 on-/off-ramps at Northeast 85th Street (Exit 18) will close day and night from 10 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 to 5 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Detours will be in place.

Daily from 9:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. on Monday, Sept. 14 and Tuesday, Sept. 15, one right lane of eastbound Interstate 90 from Shorewood to the East Channel Bridge (milepost 8) will close for maintenance.

The right lane on northbound and southbound SR 161 is closed around the clock between South 370th Street and Military Road through Sept. 2026 for fish barrier removal on three Hylebos Creek tributaries. 

One lane will remain open in each direction.

Until further notice, SR 161 is reduced to one lane in each direction between 36th Street East and Dechaux Road East on North Hill due to slide activity. Travelers can expect shifted lanes and congestion approaching North Hill.

Nightly from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Sunday, Sept. 13 to 5 a.m. Friday, Sept. 18, both directions of the State Route 167 on- and off- ramps to and from Ellingson Road (milepost 12) will close for utilities work. Expect eastbound Ellingson Road to alternate traffic with flaggers in this area.
The North Southport Drive on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.
All lanes of northbound I-405 from North Southport Drive to Coal Creek Parkway Southeast will be fully closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept 21.
Up to two lanes of northbound I-405 from North 30th Street (milepost 7) to milepost 8.5 will be closed overnight, 10 p.m. Saturday, Sept. 12 – 8 a.m. Sunday, Sept. 13.

From noon to 3 p.m. Tuesday, Sept. 8 and daily from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. (except Saturday, Sunday) beginning Wednesday, Sept. 9 to 3 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18, the right lane of southbound State Route 515 from the Interstate 405 interchange to South Puget Drive (milepost 6) will close. The sidewalk in this area will also close.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to North 30th Street will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 44th Street will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.
The North 30th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.
The Northeast 44th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed day and night, 11:30 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18 – 4 a.m. Monday, Sept. 21. Signed detours will be in place.

From 9:30 p.m. Wednesday, Sept. 16 to 4:30 a.m. Thursday, Sept. 17, two right lanes of northbound State Route 99 at State Route 518 (milepost 20) will close. The northbound SR 99 on-ramp to eastbound SR 518 will also close.

The express lanes are northbound-only 24 hours a day through the end of 2026 due to lane reductions for construction on the northbound I-5 Ship Canal Bridge. In addition, the express lanes will be closed from 11 p.m. Friday, Sept. 11, to 5 a.m. Monday, Sept. 14, for drainage work on the Ship Canal Bridge.

Daily from 5 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Saturday, Sept. 12 and Sunday, Sept. 13, one lane of the northbound State Route 99 First Avenue South bridge will close from Holden Street (milepost 26) to East Marginal Way (milepost 27) for maintenance. Crews will close the right lane on Saturday and close the left lane on Sunday.
The express lanes are closed from 11 p.m. Friday, Sept. 11, to 5 a.m. Monday, Sept. 14, for drainage work on the Ship Canal Bridge.
On the SR 520 eastbound off-ramp to Montlake Blvd (MP 1) the ramp is closed due to roadwork.
The Harvard Avenue on-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until mid-October for the Revive I-5 Ship Canal Bridge construction project.
The express lanes will operate northbound-only 24 hours a day until the end of the year, to support  Revive I-5 northbound construction.

Update 3:19 AM : On the I-5 southbound off-ramp to Union St (MP 166) there is a collision blocking the ramp and the right general purpose lane.  Medical Aid, Fire Assistance, the Incident Response Team, and the State Patrol have arrived on the scene.
From 9 p.m. Thursday, Sept. 17 to 5 a.m. Friday, Sept. 18, one right lane of northbound State Route 599 and the off-ramp to Interurban Avenue (milepost 0) will close for maintenance.
From 9 p.m. Thursday, Sept. 17 to 5 a.m. Friday, Sept. 18, one right lane of northbound Interstate 5 will close at State Route 599 (milepost 155) for maintenance.
From 9 p.m. Thursday, Sept. 17 to 5 a.m. Friday, Sept. 18 State Route 9 traffic will alternate with flaggers at Harvey Creek Road (milepost 31) for utilities work.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.

Westbound SR 524/196th Street SW has been reduced to one lane and eastbound SR 524/196th Street SW has been reduced to two lanes, 24 hours a day, near the I-5 interchange for a city of Lynnwood construction project.

From 5:30 to 10:30 a.m. Saturday, Sept. 19, the left lane of northbound Interstate 5 from the State Route 529 Steamboat Slough bridge to the Ebey Slough bridge (milepost 198) will close for maintenance. From 5:30 to 11:30 a.m. Sunday, Sept. 20, the right lane of southbound I-5 from the Ebey Slough bridge to the SR 529 Steamboat Slough bridge will close.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings crews will alternate traffic with flaggers and pilot cars in sections between a nearly 11-mile stretch of SR 203, just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20).

Nightly, from 9 p.m. until 7 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings, contractor crews will alternate traffic through the intersections of State Route 525 in Mukilteo between Paine Field and the Mukilteo Ferry Terminal for pedestrian upgrades. Pedestrians may need to use local roads to detour around the work zone.

Daily from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. beginning Monday, Sept. 14 to 2 p.m. Friday, Sept. 18, State Route 96 traffic will alternate with flaggers from East Lowell Larimer Road (milepost 5) to State Route 9/Broadway (milepost 6) for utilities work.
